title: adjoint-pair
description: A pair of functors F : C → D (left) and G : D → C (right) with a natural bijection Hom_D(F a, b) ≅ Hom_C(a, G b), equivalently a unit and counit natural transformation satisfying the triangle identities. The left adjoint is free/extending, the right adjoint forgetful/restricting. Instances: ∃ ⊣ ∀ (Lawvere), free ⊣ forgetful, ⊗ ⊣ ⊸, Galois connections, residuation.

left-adjoint.description: the free/extending functor F : C → D

right-adjoint.description: the forgetful/restricting functor G : D → C

hom-bijection.description: Hom_D(F a, b) ≅ Hom_C(a, G b), natural in a and b
